ingameEffects.label: Sleepless Eternal Night (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: The equipper's CRIT Rate is increased. DMG dealt ignores a percentage of the target's Wind RES. When the equipper uses an EX Special Attack to deal Wind DMG, Daze dealt increases by a percentage, and DMG dealt by all other squad members increases by a percentage, for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of the DMG increase effect can exist in the same squad.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: The equipper's CRIT Rate is increased.
